result.rationale: The handler compares guest emails case-sensitively: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` and blacklisted emails are lowercased (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`) while `guest` is not, so 'Bob@x.com' bypasses the blacklist and can duplicate 'bob@x.com'. The zod schema `z.string().email()` does not normalize case, so the mechanism is verifiable in the diff.
